description: Races touched by the planes of the upper heavens, aasimar bear the light of the celestial realms within their souls, serving as protectors and guides in a shadowed world.

features.name: Darkvision
features.tldr: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

features.name: Celestial Resistance
features.tldr: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

features.name: Healing Hands
features.tldr: As an action, you can touch a creature and restore a number of hit points equal to your proficiency bonus times your character level once per long rest.

features.name: Celestial Revelation
features.tldr: Choose a celestial revelation subtype reflecting your divine protector or heavenly nature.

features.name: Light Bearer
features.tldr: You know the *Light* cantrip, and Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

features.name: Celestial Revelation Unleashed
features.tldr: You gain a supernatural transformation ability (such as radiant consumption or flying wings) once per long rest.
